answer: Proof of Stake provides Sybil resistance by tying identity to capital. An agent must stake native tokens to participate, creating a dune of locked assets that acts as a barrier to entry. Much like the roots of a juniper tree anchor it against erosion, this economic cost prevents cheap identity proliferation. Each fraudulent node initiates a ripple of financial loss, as the attacker must sink vast liquidity into every unique identity, making the cost of mass impersonation prohibitive.
